FY2024.notes: FY2024 10-K presentation: CCG, DCAI and NEX under Intel Products; Intel Foundry reported separately from Q1'24; Altera and Mobileye results presented within 'All Other'.

rules.note: Altera and Mobileye are not separately quantified in this presentation; quarterly Altera/Mobileye disclosures exist in their respective 10-Qs/10-Ks and supersede this where extracted

FY2025.notes: FY2025 10-K presentation: Intel Foundry continues as a separately reported segment; Altera presented as a separate reportable segment ahead of the September 2025 majority-stake sale to Silver Lake (see intc-8k-2025-09-15); Mobileye separately reported.

2025-Q1.notes: Q1'25 transition presentation mirrors FY2024; separate Altera/Mobileye quantification appears in the segment note footnotes.

rules.note: extractor may quantify Altera/Mobileye from note disclosures; otherwise series points are absent

2025-Q2.notes: From Q2'25 Intel reported Altera as a separate operating segment.

2025-Q3.notes: Q3'25 quarter; the 8-K dated 2025-09-15 (item 2.01) closed the Altera majority-stake sale during this quarter - post-close Altera is accounted under the equity method and drops out of consolidated segment revenue from the disposition date.

2026-Q1.notes: Continues FY2025 presentation; Altera consolidated only through the Q3'25 disposition date - partial-quarter figures map with a mapping note, the engine leaves absent points missing rather than interpolating.

rules.treatment: equity-method post 2025-09-12; absent if not quantified

2026-Q2.notes: Altera deconsolidated since Q3'25; series continues from equity-method/prior-period disclosures only where present.

rules.note: no longer quantified as a consolidated segment

2026-Q3.notes: Current quarter per the FY2026 Q3 10-Q (filed 2026-10-30) and Q3'26 earnings 8-K (intc-8k-2026-10-29).

rules.note: no longer quantified as a consolidated segment

engine_interpretation.op:direct: as-reported fact field maps 1:1 to segments.<canonical>.<measure>
engine_interpretation.op:split: reported aggregate covers multiple canonical segments; if the extractor supplied child facts use them, else apply fallback_op
engine_interpretation.op:residual: store the undistributed remainder in segments.all_other_revenue / segments.all_other_operating_income
engine_interpretation.op:unavailable: canonical series point is absent for this period (no interpolation, no carry-forward)
